description: The REFUSAL, before delivery, of a data model that the O11 database upgrade refuses and TrueChange lets through: Parent reaches Message by two cascade paths (direct and via Activity). SQL Server refuses the FK (error 1785) and the publication stopped at 'Could not create foreign key constraint ... circular dependency between entities' (OfficePet_CS, 2026-10-04). The kernel reads the effective model (base + job) after the apply and before saving, and says which reference to swap. The same job with ActivityId Ignore passes (DatabaseUpgradeRulesTests); ODC (PostgreSQL) accepts both paths (OdcDatabaseUpgradeRulesTests).
expectError: set Delete Rule to Ignore or Protect
op #0 (spec Message.ActivityId): Message.ActivityId: set Delete Rule to Ignore or Protect
Parent reaches Message by two cascade paths: Parent->Activity->Message [Activity.ParentId, Message.ActivityId] and Parent->Message [Message.ParentId]
